run_train_summary: run the train command to summarize RL training logs with reward metrics and test results
run_test_summary: run the test command to print test set results with instruction count and object size reduction
run_test_latex: run the test command with latex formatting to output reduction metrics in dollar-sign notation
review_models_from_paths: review the models_from_paths function to load Model objects from a list of log directory paths
summarize_train_command: summarize the train command output showing episodes, training time, and geomean rewards in a psql table
